Reading.title: Blood Sugar Reading
Reading.description: A single blood sugar measurement at a specific time.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this reading

AccessRequest.title: Access Request
AccessRequest.description: A request from a guest to view an owner's data.

SharedPermission.title: Shared Permission
SharedPermission.description: Record of granted access from owner to guest.

/readings/{readingId}.description: Collection of blood sugar readings. Owners can read/write their own data. Approved guests can read the owner's data.

/requests/{requestId}.description: Access requests. Any authenticated user can create a request. Owners can read and delete requests directed to their email.

/permissions/{permissionId}.description: Active viewing permissions. Owners can create/delete permissions. Guests can read permissions granted to their email.
